meta.title: Vigia: chat moderator for Twitch
meta.description: Vigia moderates your Twitch stream's chat: it deletes spam and insults, hides spoilers and puts questions on your OBS overlay. Free, open source, and runs on your PC.
hero.eyebrow: Free · Open source · For Twitch streamers
hero.title: A lookout for your chat.
hero.lead: Vigia moderates your stream's chat: it deletes spam and insults, hides spoilers, and puts chat's questions on an OBS overlay. It runs on your PC.
hero.note: Version 0.1.0, experimental. Start in observe mode: Vigia only marks what it would do.
f1.title: Moderates
f1.body: Deletes spam and times out insults. When it isn't sure, it leaves the message for a mod to decide.
f2.title: Hides spoilers
f2.body: Spots spoilers for the game you're playing and hides them, including in your dashboard.
f3.title: Highlights questions
f3.body: Puts chat's questions and good messages on an OBS overlay.

start.1.title: Install it
start.1.body: With the app for Windows, macOS or Linux, or with Docker.
start.2.title: Set it up
start.2.body: A window guides you. It takes about ten minutes.
start.3.title: Start by watching
start.3.body: Vigia only marks what it would do. Once you're happy with it, turn moderation on.
install.needs: You need a Jev key, which costs cents per night. To moderate your channel, you also need your own Twitch app, which is free.
footer.made: Free and open source, MIT license. Uses Jev, by TypeSafe AI.
